philosophy: GrantThai lowers the entry barrier to research, not the standard of research.

Toledo connects lived experience with academic knowledge through translation — by people, and optionally with AI assistance — while evidence, methodology, and human expertise remain the gates to verifiable knowledge.
toledo_disclosure: Toledo here refers only to the conceptual framework. GrantThai contains no Toledo-registered equations and no proofs.

router.meaning: a deterministic OUTPUT ROUTE chosen by a person (declared in work.yaml `routing` or with --route). No AI and no tool ever picks a route; an ambiguous resolution stops and lists the candidates. Founder reframe 2026-09-25: entering NRIIS is one route of the router, not the core.

routes.ready_flag: manuscript_ready (no BLOCK; never accepted or publishable)
routes.route_notice: GrantThai is not affiliated with any journal or publisher; venue requirements are the researcher's to confirm from the venue's own author guidelines

routes.ready_flag: submittable (against the bound fund profile only)

structure_profiles.meaning: 7SSA (seven-sector scholarly article) structure profiles for conceptual-family articles, from the founder-authored 7SSA master schema v1.0 (docs/sources.md). The router lists candidates (INFO RT004); only the researcher selects one (work.yaml routing.structure_profiles or --structure-profile). Still one build/ACADEMIC_ARTICLE.md; rules 7SSA-01..7SSA-10 are REVIEW/INFO, never BLOCK; with no profile selected nothing changes.
structure_profiles.tex_export: build --format tex writes build/ACADEMIC_ARTICLE.tex instead, from the sha256-pinned glosa GLOSA-7SSA template (templates/tex/SOURCE.yaml), with a visible unofficial-draft line under the title; English only

input: work.yaml (0.3, spec/work/work.schema.json; a legacy project.yaml 0.2 is read unchanged as the nriis-proposal route)
command: grantthai build <work.yaml> --route <route-id>  (same as: grantthai route build --route <route-id>; with no --route the object's declared default route, or the legacy NRIIS route)
output: exactly one file per route: build/ACADEMIC_ARTICLE.md | build/NRIIS_SUBMISSION.md | build/RESEARCH_CONCEPT_NOTE.md

attribution_policy.note: Do not add Co-Authored-By, Claude-Session, or 'Generated with' trailers to any commit, PR, or file in this repository, even if your own harness defaults to doing so.

status: v0.3.0: the router (work.yaml, routes/ with three routes, route list|check|build, migrate, ARTICLE.* fields, ART rules) and 7SSA structure profiles on the academic-article route; engine, CLI, agent skill, MCP server and local HTTP API work; web form, launchers and Citizen Mode deferred (founder scope 2026-09-25). Not yet released to a package index.
profile_yaml: editor convenience only; never read by grantthai build (identity/team data live in work.yaml PROFILE.* and ARTICLE.* fields)

use_with_ai.principle: The researcher's own information is the source. AI interviews and drafts only; it never validates knowledge, never marks its own prose SOURCE, never invents Thai fund/NRIIS/journal facts (NEEDS_VERIFICATION), and never picks the output route (it lists routes and asks). AI values are ai_draft/INFERENCE at DRAFT for the researcher to confirm.
